{{Quote|Good day to you citizen and welcome to the reward store for the Galactic Vacant Building Demolishing Movement. Here at G.V.B.D.M we reward those that like blowing up empty building as much as we do and that's why I'm here.|Jag Silon|<ref name="SWG:TCOA">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>}}
'''Jag Silon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who acted as a rewards agent for the [[Galactic Vacant Building Demolishing Movement|G.V.B.D.M]]. He set up shop on one of the lower levels of the ''[[Lucky Despot]]'' [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
